rows.ja: 供給元(部品・メモリー)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: エンタープライズSSDの開発・販売で長期の提携。PhisonがNANDコントローラーなどを供給
relations.text_en: Long-term partnership on development and distribution of enterprise-class SSDs; Phison supplies NAND flash controller and storage solutions

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: The companies also announced that they have entered a long-term partnership that will strengthen the development cycle and distribution of enterprise-class SSDs.
source.note: 2022年の発表で、現在の状況は再確認していません。
source.note_en: A 2022 release; the current status has not been re-confirmed.

relations.text: 東芝メモリ(現Kioxia)と長期のNAND供給契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a long-term NAND supply agreement with Toshiba Memory Corporation (now Kioxia)

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: Long-term NAND supply agreement with Toshiba Memory Corporation signed to benefit portfolio expansion and portfolio continuity
source.note: 2018年の発表で、現在の状況は確認していません。社名はその後Kioxiaに変わりました。
source.note_en: A 2018 release; the current status is not verified. Toshiba Memory was later renamed Kioxia.

relations.text: ベインキャピタル主導の、東芝メモリ(現Kioxia)を買収するコンソーシアムに出資
relations.text_en: Invested in the Bain Capital-led consortium that acquired Toshiba Memory Corporation (now Kioxia)

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: completed the previously announced acquisition of Toshiba Memory Corporation by K. K. Pangea
source.note: 2018年の出資で、現在の持分は確認していません。
source.note_en: A 2018 investment; the current stake is not verified.

relations.text: SeagateがHDD用サスペンション部品の供給元として名前を挙げ、反トラスト法違反の損害賠償を求めている
relations.text_en: Named as an HDD suspension assembly supplier against which Seagate is pursuing antitrust claims

source.label: Seagate 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: against suppliers of HDD suspension assemblies, including NHK Spring Co. Ltd. (“NHK”), TDK Corporation (“TDK”) and Hutchinson Technology Inc
source.note: 供給契約ではなく、訴訟の中で述べられた関係です。
source.note_en: The relationship is described through litigation, not a supply agreement.

relations.text: SeagateのHDD用サスペンション部品の供給元として名前が挙げられた反トラスト訴訟
relations.text_en: Named as an HDD suspension assembly supplier in Seagate’s antitrust action

source.label: Seagate 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: against suppliers of HDD suspension assemblies, including NHK Spring Co. Ltd. (“NHK”), TDK Corporation (“TDK”) and Hutchinson Technology Inc
source.note: TDKに対する請求は2022年に和解済みで、訴訟を通じて述べられた関係です。
source.note_en: Claims against TDK were settled in 2022; the relationship is described via litigation.

relations.text: Dellが、Seagate Mozaic 3+を最初に採用する顧客の1社で、Exos M 32TBドライブを自社ストレージに組み込む
relations.text_en: Dell is among the first customers to adopt Seagate Mozaic 3+ and will integrate Exos M 32TB drives into its storage systems

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: Dell Technologies is among the first customers to adopt Mozaic 3+ and will soon integrate Exos M 32TB into their high-density storage systems.
source.note: 組み込みは発表時点では今後の予定でした。
source.note_en: The integration was described as upcoming at the time of the release.

relations.text: DropboxがHAMR技術のExos 32TBドライブ(Mozaic)をデータセンター向けに認定
relations.text_en: Dropbox qualified Seagate HAMR-based Exos 32TB drives (Mozaic platform) for deployment in its data centers

source.label: Seagate の記事
source.label_en: Seagate Stories: Powering AI at scale
source.quote: Dropbox successfully qualified Seagate's HAMR-enabled Exos® 32TB hard drives
source.note: 導入の認定で、数量は書かれていません。
source.note_en: Qualification for deployment; volume is not stated.

relations.text: Zoomの顧客が会議の録画をSeagate Lyve Cloudに保存できるようにする
relations.text_en: Zoom agreed to let its customers store meeting recordings on Seagate Lyve Cloud

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: reached an agreement with Zoom that will soon enable the video conferencing company’s customers to use Seagate Lyve™ Cloud to store meeting recordings.
source.note: 2021年の発表で、現在の状況は再確認していません。
source.note_en: A 2021 release; the current status has not been re-confirmed.

relations.text: Seagate Lyve ServicesとExos XシステムをAWS Marketplace・AWS Outpostsなどと連携
relations.text_en: Seagate Lyve Services and Exos X systems are integrated with AWS services, including AWS Marketplace and AWS Outposts

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: Seagate's Lyve Services portfolio is now integrated with many AWS services
source.note: 相手はAmazonの事業部門のAmazon Web Servicesです。
source.note_en: The counterparty is Amazon Web Services, a unit of Amazon.

relations.text: Xbox Series X|S用のSeagate拡張ストレージカードを、Xbox(Microsoft)と共同で設計
relations.text_en: Seagate’s Storage Expansion Card for Xbox Series X|S was designed in collaboration with Xbox (Microsoft)

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.label_en: Seagate press release (4TB Xbox expansion card)
source.quote: Designed in collaboration with Xbox, this expansion card delivers plug-and-play simplicity
source.note: 資料にはMicrosoftではなくXbox(Microsoftのブランド)と書かれています。
source.note_en: The source names Xbox (a Microsoft brand), not Microsoft itself.

relations.text: PS5・PS4向けのPlayStation公式ライセンスのGame Drive外付けSSDを販売
relations.text_en: Seagate sells a Game Drive External SSD officially licensed by PlayStation for PS5 and PS4 consoles

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.label_en: Seagate press release (PlayStation licensed Game Drive)
source.quote: Seagate Announces Game Drive External SSD Officially Licensed by PlayStation® for PlayStation®5 and PlayStation®4 Consoles
source.note: 資料にはSony GroupではなくPlayStation(Sony Interactive Entertainment)と書かれています。
source.note_en: The source names PlayStation (Sony Interactive Entertainment), not Sony Group.

relations.text: eBayと持続可能性の協業で合意し、SeagateのeBay店舗を工場で再認定したドライブの販売チャネルにする
relations.text_en: Agreed a sustainability collaboration with eBay making Seagate’s eBay storefront a channel for factory-recertified drives

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: announced its sustainability collaboration with e-commerce site eBay.
source.note: 部品の供給関係ではなく、販売・循環利用の提携です。
source.note_en: A sales-channel and circularity tie, not a component supply relationship.

relations.text: EquinixはLyve Cloudのエコシステムに参加するクラウド提携先の1社
relations.text_en: Equinix is part of the Lyve Cloud ecosystem network of cloud partners

source.label: Seagate の発表
source.quote: Lyve Cloud now has over 50 companies in its ecosystem network, including Zadara, Equinix and PacketFabric
source.note: 2022年の発表で、現在の状況は再確認していません。
source.note_en: A 2022 release; the current status has not been re-confirmed.

relations.text: 2024年4月、SoCの設計・開発・製造に関する資産をBroadcom子会社のAvagoに売却
relations.text_en: Sold its SoC design, development and manufacturing assets to Broadcom subsidiary Avago in April 2024

source.label: Seagate 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: the Company entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Avago Technologies International Sales Pte. Limited (“Purchaser”), a subsidiary of Broadcom Inc., and sold certain intellectual property, equipment and other assets related to the design, development and manufacture of its SoC products to Purchaser.
source.note: 取引は2024年4月23日で、10-Kに記載されています。
source.note_en: The transaction was on April 23, 2024, as described in the FY2026 10-K.

relations.text: Seagateが年次報告で、世界のHDDの競合としてWestern Digitalを挙げている
relations.text_en: Seagate’s FY2026 10-K lists Western Digital as a global HDD competitor

source.label: Seagate 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our global competitors include HDD manufacturers such as Western Digital Corporation

relations.text: Western Digitalが年次報告で、HDDの競合としてSeagateを挙げている
relations.text_en: Western Digital’s FY2026 10-K lists Seagate as an HDD competitor

source.label: Western Digital 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include HDD competitors such as Seagate Technology Holdings plc

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
